agent_talk.desc: Paired idle conversations with alternating speech.

agent_wallet.desc: Show measured shipped source additions and dollar totals for agents and the office.

agent_spending.desc: Agents spend measured money: buy_food idle activity at registered vendors (vending = agent's own book, taco truck seam = office book).

demo_economy.desc: Demo floor only: seed a deterministic starting office balance and seat earnings so demo vendors (taco truck, vending) can be paid.

multi_floor_v2.desc: Per-floor economy in a multi-floor building: each floor's office book and seat earnings are its own, and a visible elevator prop rides the floor switcher. Single-floor serves are unchanged.

living_demo.desc: Demo floors only: force the demo economy flags on for serve --demo and the public web-demo bake; a live floor is unchanged.

office_excursions.desc: Scene-teleport infrastructure: OfficeExcursion.start(scene) sends idle seats to a registered fiction scene. No scene is scheduled by default.

cockpit_chat.desc: Enable the founder-to-CEO cockpit chat client.

store_coming_soon.desc: Coming-soon fallback surface when the catalog authority is unavailable.

costview_live.desc: Mount the observed-usage CostView; off = COMING SOON card.

boxing_in_webdemo.desc: Include boxing modules in the public web-demo build.

iso_basis_scale.desc: Scale sprite4 draws from the declared source basis instead of opaque-width fit.

webgl_floor.desc: Render the floor with the WebGL/three.js parallel renderer instead of Canvas-2D.

webgl_plate_themes.desc: Render data-enabled static office plates behind WebGL agents; Manhattan is enabled and Tokyo is parked pending replacement art.

npc_random_events.desc: Enable NPC random events (UFO abduction of a benched seat + activity arbitration).

agent_animation.desc: Real walk/run gait, 8-way facing, and smoking/drinking/eating animation for WebGL floor agents.

agent_appearance.desc: Apply each browser's saved Agent Manager appearance choices to live floor avatars.

agent_needs.desc: Enable session-only fictional agent vitals and needs-weighted safe idle behavior.

agent_lives.desc: Agent lives: a Life tab in the Agent Manager plus a deterministic, rate-limited idle speech-bubble bank. Turns on no other flag; each section degrades to what is on.

naughty_mode.desc: Permit signed-in, age-attested accounts to activate live-only M2 naughty content.

store_live.desc: Mount the live marketplace store panel (catalog + purchase over /api/customization).

npc_vignettes.desc: R4 kill-switch: show the live NPC vignette cast. Default ON since the founder ruling of 2026-09-01; set false to hide the cast.

npc_story_mode.desc: Encounters story-state layer: fiction outcomes write per-agent story-state (simulated only).

agent_influence.desc: Enable bounded, reversible fictional office consequences from vignette and encounter outcomes.

collector_mechanical_status.desc: Derive seat STATUS from observed session activity instead of the self-reported OUTBOX block.

officefloor_service.desc: Wire the shared officefloor.ai floor service into the product surface.

hosted_sync.desc: Enable explicit hosted config sync for a credentialed local floor.

public_room_creation.desc: Let a visitor mint a room from the door without the operator token (guardrailed: rate-limited, capped). Default-flip reverses founder-ruling-13 and is founder-gated.

agent_drive_home.desc: DRIVE-HOME-02 fiction: idle and benched agents clock out at the go-home hour, get into their car through an animated driver door, drive home, and return when the office opens. Real work recalls them at once. Off = the original single clock-out vignette.

agent_activity_events.desc: Read the org's hook event log (.org-events/events.jsonl) into live agent activity: working/idle/unknown. Events animate; STATUS still decides meaning.

store_item_art.desc: Use Blender-rendered art for the 56 public store preview items.

office_pet_dog.desc: Adoptable office dog: bought in the store with office money, fed daily in office money; rehomed after 3 unpaid days.

economy_view.desc: Economy mini pane, top-bar pill and full-screen view over the read-only /api/economy feed.

office_basketball_court.desc: Add an outdoor half court behind the office (north of review), reached by a back door, where idle agents shoot hoops.

blackjack.desc: Idle agents play seeded fiction-only blackjack (¢r scrip, no wallet): an OFFICE EVENT prompt offers a watchable 2D table, hands play out in 20-30 s.

activity_collapsed_default.desc: Floor activity panel starts collapsed (compact row) until the viewer expands it; a stored viewer preference still wins.

store_hide_empty_categories.desc: Store rail hides categories with no items, and (with store_item_art) categories none of whose items have art yet; Featured follows the visible rail.

store_aisles_v2.desc: Store v2: venue Theme SKUs (beach/manhattan/naruto/tokyo) that activate through the existing theme switch, plus Featured-wide search.

rave_schedule.desc: With office_excursions on, the rave scene offers its consent prompt once a week: Friday 18:00 on the office clock (core.weeklyWindow(5, 18)). Off: the rave stays registered but unscheduled.

office_calendar.desc: Weekly office rhythm: the clock pill names the current/next event, a 'This week' list sits in the HUD, idle agents gather for Birthday cake, and Beer o'clock boosts the beer idle pick when a tap is placed. Off: no pill event text, no list, no idle-weight change.

director_mode.desc: Director mode: install window.director + window.__office3d so a filming seat can drive the floor camera, go chrome-free (?film=1), set an aspect box and record. Off: nothing installs and the floor is unchanged.

city_customization.desc: City customization (founder 2026-10-17): placed store items render inside the Manhattan/Tokyo worlds on the city's placement grid, re-coloured with the city palette; later, edit mode in city zones. Off: city worlds draw only their authored scene.
